title: Importance weighted active learning
bias_correction_device: inverse-propensity weighting of actively queried labels
relation_to_this_work: Origin of the device this project borrows. Corrects the risk estimate, not a calibration functional; no pool-marginal estimand; the corrected quantity does not steer acquisition.

title: UPAL: Unbiased Pool Based Active Learning
estimand: risk of a hypothesis over the pool
closes_the_loop: partly - the estimator defines the learner
relation_to_this_work: Closest ancestor for the pool-marginal idea, but the functional is risk, not calibration, and the correction serves learning rather than monitoring.

title: On Statistical Bias In Active Learning: How and When To Fix It
relation_to_this_work: Shows active-selection bias can help or hurt. Directly supports the premise; estimand is again risk, and nothing is measured over the unlabeled pool.

title: A Conditional Expectation Approach to Model Selection and Active Learning under Covariate Shift
relation_to_this_work: Covariate-shift weighting inside active design, predating the modern literature. Estimand is generalization error, not calibration.

title: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
estimand: marginal coverage of a prediction set
relation_to_this_work: The canonical P+C result. Static two-sample covariate shift with a known or estimated likelihood ratio; no sequential loop, no acquisition.

title: Conformal prediction under feedback covariate shift for biomolecular design
estimand: coverage of prediction sets at the DESIGNED points
bias_correction_device: likelihood-ratio weighting for shift induced by the design algorithm itself
relation_to_this_work: The nearest prior art. Same recognition that the selector induces its own shift, and the same weighting remedy. Differs on the estimand (coverage at the designed queries, not calibration over the unlabeled pool), on the protocol (single design round, not a monitored campaign), and in that the corrected quantity never re-enters the selection rule.

title: Bayesian Optimization with Conformal Prediction Sets
estimand: coverage of the posterior predictive at query points
bias_correction_device: conformal correction for covariate shift inside the acquisition
relation_to_this_work: Closes a loop with a shift-corrected uncertainty object, so it contests the loop-closing claim. But the object is a per-query prediction set feeding utility, not an estimate of a pool-level calibration functional, and selection probabilities are never logged or used.

title: Online Calibrated and Conformal Prediction Improves Bayesian Optimization
estimand: calibration of the surrogate's predictive intervals along the query stream
bias_correction_device: online learning - no propensities, no weighting
relation_to_this_work: The most important comparator and a mandatory baseline arm: it attacks the same action-dependent-data problem without propensities. Its guarantee is on the realised query sequence; this project's estimand is the pool marginal. If the pool-marginal reading is not shown to matter, this work already suffices.

title: Robust Bayesian Optimization via Localized Online Conformal Prediction
estimand: localized coverage of the GP surrogate
relation_to_this_work: Current state of the art on the online-calibration route; a second baseline arm alongside the 2021 work.

title: Calibration of uncertainty in the active learning of machine learning force fields
relation_to_this_work: Materials-side evidence that recalibration inside an AL loop changes outcomes. Recalibrates on the selected sample with no bias correction, which is exactly the naive-monitor arm this project treats as a baseline.

title: Uncertainty estimation affects predictor selection and its calibration improves materials optimization
estimand: calibration of uncertainty for alloy property predictors
relation_to_this_work: Strong motivation on real alloy datasets that calibration quality changes optimization outcomes; measured on the selected sample, with the selection-bias question not raised.

title: On the Quality of Uncertainty Estimates from Neural Network Potential Ensembles
relation_to_this_work: Measurement-only reference for how surrogate uncertainty is assessed in this domain.

title: Correcting selection bias in active learning based on selective inference framework
estimand: post-selection inference for the actively chosen sample
relation_to_this_work: An alternative formal route to the same bias; worth citing as the non-propensity alternative to the correction device.

title: Debiasing the Human-Recommender System Feedback Loop in Collaborative Filtering
relation_to_this_work: Nearest analogue of the closed-loop argument outside ML theory: a policy biases the data that trains the policy. Estimand is recommendation utility, not calibration.

title: Active Sampling: A Machine-Learning-Assisted Framework for Finite Population Inference with Optimal Subsamples
relation_to_this_work: Supplies the survey-sampling vocabulary (design weights, finite-population target) this project's pool-marginal estimand sits in.

title: A study of the role of data and model uncertainty in active learning
estimand: effect of data vs model uncertainty on AL performance
relation_to_this_work: The citation the original proposal attributed to 2025; it exists but is 2024. Decomposes uncertainty in materials AL without touching the selection-bias question.

title: Design-marginal calibration of Gaussian process predictive distributions: Bayesian and conformal approaches
estimand: mu-coverage / probabilistic calibration of a GP, averaged over a DESIGN MEASURE
bias_correction_device: none - cross-validated standardized leave-one-out residuals, conformal predictive systems
closes_the_loop: no - but explicitly aimed at sequential design
relation_to_this_work: Names and formalises the estimand this project calls pool-marginal calibration, and uses the same standardized leave-one-out residual construction. The design measure is given and the residuals come from cross-validation on an existing design; the sample is never one the acquisition rule chose, and no selection probability is logged. The estimand and the residual device are therefore surrendered; the adaptive-sample estimation problem is not.

title: Portfolio allocation for Bayesian optimization (GP-Hedge)
estimand: cumulative reward of an acquisition portfolio
closes_the_loop: yes - switches acquisition on observed reward
relation_to_this_work: Policy-switching control without any reliability signal. Belongs in the arm list as the switching baseline that does not read calibration.

title: No-PASt-BO: Normalized Portfolio Allocation Strategy for Bayesian Optimization
estimand: cumulative reward of an acquisition portfolio
relation_to_this_work: As GP-Hedge, with normalized and forgetting-weighted rewards. Arm-list control, not prior art for the estimand.
